useCases.title: Run one eval across many models
useCases.summary: Loop the same prompts over many models
useCases.problem: Evaluating models from different vendors means one SDK and one key per provider, and cost lands on separate invoices you have to add up.

snippets.title: Eval loop

steps: Run anyr models (or open /models) and pick the ids you want to compare.
Send the same prompt to each id through one AI SDK provider.
Compare outputs and token usage, then check cost per request in Dashboard → Logs.
